user.title: Oil tank
user.description: Choose the sensor that measures your tank and what it reports.

data_description.depth_entity: The sensor on your oil tank. It needs long-term statistics (state class "measurement") for the history and estimates.
data_description.level_type: A distance sensor (e.g. ultrasonic) measures from the sensor down to the oil. Many ready-made gauges report percent full or litres instead.
data_description.tank_capacity: How many litres the tank holds when full.

shape.title: Tank shape
shape.description: Used to turn the measured distance into litres. Measure from the sensor down to the oil surface when the tank is full, and down to the level where it should be treated as empty.

data_description.tank_shape: Most plastic bunded tanks are close to upright. Pick "Custom" if you have a measured table for your tank.
data_description.full_distance_cm: Sensor-to-oil distance with a full tank.
data_description.empty_distance_cm: Sensor-to-oil distance at the bottom (or the pump outlet).
data_description.calibration: Only for the custom shape: distance:percent pairs, e.g. "10:100, 60:50, 110:0". Overrides the two distances above.

sensors.title: Temperatures and weather
sensors.description: These drive the usage estimates. Estimates start after about 6 complete, clean weeks of history.

data.stale_after_minutes: Warn when the tank reading is older than (minutes)
data.weather_history: Use long-term weather history for winter scenarios
data.history_location: Town or postcode for weather history (optional)

data_description.outdoor_entity: A temperature sensor with long-term statistics, in °C or °F.
data_description.indoor_entity: A room or thermostat temperature sensor with long-term statistics.
data_description.indoor_target_entity: Your thermostat (climate entity) or a sensor holding its target temperature.
data_description.weather_entity: A weather entity that provides seven daily forecasts.
data_description.runtime_entity: Hours the heating has run today, resetting daily. Improves accuracy; leave empty if you don't have one.
data_description.timestamp_entity: When the tank sensor actually took its reading. Useful for radio/MQTT sensors with retained messages; leave empty to use the time Home Assistant received the reading.
data_description.stale_after_minutes: Set this a little longer than your sensor's normal reporting interval.
data_description.tank_temp_entity: Air temperature at the tank sensor. Ultrasonic sensors read slightly long in cold air; Oil Monitor checks your history for this and corrects it if needed. Leave empty to use the outdoor temperature.
data_description.weather_history: Downloads about 25 years of daily temperatures for your area from Open-Meteo (free, no account) to project mild, typical and cold winters. Only an approximate location, rounded to about 10 km, is sent. Turn off to keep everything local.
data_description.history_location: A town, or the first part of your postcode (e.g. YO10). Leave empty to use Home Assistant's home location. Either way it is rounded to about 10 km.

error.invalid_calibration: The table could not be read. Use distance:percent pairs, e.g. 10:100, 60:50, 110:0.
error.empty_not_below_full: The empty distance must be larger than the full distance (the oil is further from the sensor when the tank is empty).
